summary.text: Tullio Liberati is a Democratic member of the Michigan House of Representatives serving his second term for District 2, which encompasses Allen Park, Lincoln Park and Ecorse.
His caucus page lists him as Majority Vice Chair of the Joint Committee on Administrative Rules.

paragraphs.text: Born and raised in Allen Park, Liberati attended St. Frances Cabrini High School and Wayne State University, where he spent summers working construction and discovered his interest in masonry.
He is a licensed builder and community-focused entrepreneur and is active with the Allen Park Democratic Club.
He has lived in the 2nd House District for nearly five decades with his wife, and they have two children who graduated from Allen Park Public Schools.
